others.route: Visitor's visa with section 11(2) work authorisation

note: South Africa: a person in the entertainment industry travelling through the Republic to perform, or an actor in a film or advertisement produced there, for a foreign employer, may do that work on a visitor's visa with the authorisation under section 11(2) of the Immigration Act, applied for at a mission before travelling (Immigration Regulations reg. 11). No days of performing without the authorisation are named.

sources.title: Acts Online, Immigration Regulations (R413 of 2014), regulation 11: Visitor's visa
sources.said: work conducted for a foreign employer pursuant to a contract which partially requires conducting of certain activities in the Republic and relates to— ... in respect of films and advertisements produced in South Africa, including, but not limited to, an actor, cameraman, hairstylist, make-up artist or lighting and sound engineer; ... a person involved in the entertainment industry, travelling through the Republic to perform;
